capabilities: Show tasks from daily notes as blocks on an editable timeline
Display Tasks-plugin tasks from any vault file on the timeline
Pull events from Google, iCloud, and Outlook calendars via ICS links
Record time spent on tasks with start/stop clocks stored as Dataview properties
Preview the next three hours in a status-bar mini-timeline
extras: The time-tracking feature is explicitly marked experimental and may change; the plugin is free with a request for donations.
intentEvidence: Thanks to James Lynch for the original plugin
problem: Obsidian has no visual day timeline for scheduling tasks from notes and no built-in way to track time spent on them.

relations.evidence: tasks community plugin integration, showing events from other files in your vault
Day Planner is integrated with - The core Daily Notes plugin.
Thanks to James Lynch for the original plugin
You can record time spent on tasks in the form of Dataview properties
Thanks to Toggl Track for an idea of a great time-tracking UI

requires.name: Google, iCloud, or Outlook calendar account for ICS links

summary: Day planner that turns tasks from daily notes, the Tasks plugin, and online calendars into an editable timeline with time tracking.
